text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out with Yamanin
Zephyr...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her gaze is fixed on a claw machine
filled with
Umamusume plushies.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The glass is keeping them from
feeling the
wind...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
If only I could free them, and let them
bathe in
the breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I don't have much experience with claw
machines,
though, so I imagine any
efforts I make will prove
fruitless.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Are you sure? That would be wonderful.
choice_data_list: Shall I get it for you?
Want me to get that for you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
